reuse.why: Adds the rule inside the existing link.findOrCreateLinkedAccount, which every provider reaches through linkBankAccount, and reuses the account row the function already loaded.

duplication.why: The upgrading-account lookup is moved, not copied, so it can be checked before findOrCreateBank; nothing is duplicated.

placement.why: link.ts is where the tree keeps link rules; the check could have been a small assert beside assertBankAccountNotLinked, but inline in the shared linker is still the right layer.

scope.why: A focused reorder in one function plus tests for refusal, reopen and re-link.

maintainability.why: One code path enforces the rule before any write; the error string is an inline literal rather than a named constant, which is a minor point.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider links go through findOrCreateLinkedAccount.

one_place.where: The closed-account check is in link.findOrCreateLinkedAccount, which linkBankAccount calls for every provider.
